lastText: The Night EndsThe Court FallsNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 15ATTACK ON A HOUSE AT PURFLEET: MANY INJUREDThey come at noon. The servants stand in the hall with their hands at their sides and do not run. You are in the chapel in the box, with a little of your strength and none of your hope. The hunters are not quick, and they are very thorough, and they have brought a great deal of bread. By evening the chapel is quiet and the hall is empty. Somewhere in the garden, a man in a nightshirt is crying for a bird. The tellings differ, but they agree on one thing: that whatever he did, he did it in a great hurry, as if he were afraid there would not be enough time. People remember that he wept. A girl from the village says that she saw him, on the night of the storm, standing on the cliff with his hands over his face.
